policy: REAL repeats; calibration OFF=raw KK, ON=isotonic leave-one-dataset-out; no leakage, no fabrication.

G3_auroc_diagnosis.interpretation: Within a dataset KK barely ranks reproducibility (mean within-AUROC near 0.5); across datasets the per-dataset mean KK is NEGATIVELY related to replication rate (Spearman -0.20), so a model that transfers KK across datasets scores BELOW chance. => KK encodes single-curve validity, which is largely orthogonal to (and here mildly anti-correlated with) cross-pellet reproducibility; this is the diagnosis of AUROC<0.5.
